profile.summary: A small Oakland nonprofit focused on music and the arts. It mentors emerging artists, produces music, and fiscally sponsors community choirs and gospel ensembles. Its stated mission includes educating and offering musician services to underserved communities and working with youth to develop their artistic talents.
